source_locator: Certificate of City Clerk (corrected 7/11/16), FOR THE OFFICE OF MAYOR
verification_note: The certificate shows Kevin Faulconer 181147 (57.16%), Lori Saldana 73932 (23.33%) and Ed Harris 61458 (19.39%). Total for office of mayor is 316537. Faulconer won a majority, and the City Clerk mayoral history lists the runoff as none. The rule is San Diego Charter Article II Section 10 as amended 06-03-2014 (effective 07-24-2014, in force on 2016-06-07): all elective officers are nominated at the municipal primary, and a candidate who receives a majority of votes cast for all candidates for nomination is declared elected. Voters replaced this text on 11-08-2016 (effective 12-19-2016), after this election. The Clerk mayoral history PDF is kept only as a results cross-check.
total_votes_basis: total for office of mayor in the certificate, citywide, all three candidates
